# Speech Studio

> A Windows desktop studio for voice on the user's own computer. Speech voices text — a line, a dialog with a voice per character, a podcast the director writes, a book from EPUB, FB2, PDF or DOCX, subtitles into their cues — with Higgs Audio v3, Fish Audio Drama 3, Supertonic 3 and Qwen3-TTS (Russian stress included) or cloud voices, with takes checked by recognition, and exports WAV, FLAC, MP3, OGG, M4A or M4B with chapters and subtitles. Listening turns audio, video, a link or the microphone into a transcript with speakers and word times (Parakeet-TDT, Nemotron 3.5, Whisper or cloud recognisers), cuts it by text, checks a voicing against its text and lays a known text over a recording. Live is a voice channel for an agent: the agent speaks each finished phrase at once and hears the person phrase by phrase, and speaking over it stops it. While it is open it serves an MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:8797/mcp that an agent uses to do everything the studio does, and an OpenAI-compatible audio API on the same port.

For an agent given this repository: install the studio from the latest release, start it, connect to its MCP server, and read the skill the server serves (resource `studio://skill`) - it names every tool and the ground rules. Start every session with the tool `studio_status`. To talk with the person by voice, use `voice_listen_start`, `voice_listen` and `say_start` / `say_text` (the skill's Live section).

## Connect

- MCP endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:8797/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON-RPC)
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http speech-studio http://127.0.0.1:8797/mcp`
- Other clients: `{ "mcpServers": { "speech-studio": { "type": "streamable-http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8797/mcp" } } }`
- OpenAI audio API: `POST http://127.0.0.1:8797/v1/audio/speech`, `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions`, `GET /v1/models`; speech also takes the engine's project settings: `seed`, `temperature`, `top_k`, `top_p`, `max_tokens`, `steps` (Supertonic), `loudness` (off, video, podcast, acx)
- Only programs on this computer and the studio's own window may connect.

## Docs

- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timoncool/speech-studio/main/docs/mcp-skill.md): every tool by area and the ground rules (the same text the server serves as `studio://skill`)
- [README](https://github.com/timoncool/speech-studio#readme): what the studio does, what it needs, how it works
- [Latest release](https://github.com/timoncool/speech-studio/releases/latest): the installer and the portable archive
- [Site](https://timoncool.github.io/speech-studio/): examples of every engine and the engines measured on an RTX 4090

## Optional

- Install the skill for Claude Code: save [docs/mcp-skill.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timoncool/speech-studio/main/docs/mcp-skill.md) as `~/.claude/skills/speech-studio/SKILL.md`
